title: A function named by evidence (one row of research/coverage/functions.jsonl)
description: The name of one function of the game's code, keyed by its binary and its start. Written by `gatekit decomp name`, shown by `gatekit decomp at` and `gatekit decomp names`. A row holds an address and our own words, never code of the game. docs/contracts/cli.md, "decomp name".

binary.description: The module: bg3_dx11.exe, bg3.exe, a Toolkit DLL.

rva.description: The function's start in the module.

name.description: The name, with :: between its parts.

source.description: Where the name comes from: game and toolkit are facts, inferred is reasoning from the game's code and needs its evidence, extender is Script Extender's name, unknown says so.

evidence.description: What backs the name: what an instrument read, forced or repeated, and where.

does.description: Our own sentence on what the function does.

legacy.description: Names the function had before: aliases.

vars.description: The function's own variables and parameters: the decompiler's name to ours (`decomp vars`).

structs.description: Which structure a variable points at: the variable to the structure of structs.jsonl.

build.description: The Steam build of the game the address is in (`gatekit registry stamp`).

fingerprint.description: Facts that find the function again in another build (`gatekit registry stamp`).

size.description: Bytes of the function in this build.

body.description: The hash of its masked body in this build.
